newsitem.title: THAILAND: Draco settles bonus dispute with workers.
newsitem.headline: Draco settles bonus dispute with workers.

text.p: Thai electronics firm Draco PCB Plc said on Friday it had resolved a dispute with workers over annual bonus payments which sparked a staff walkout during the late shift on December 25.
The company said it had agreed to raise employee bonuses after negotiations the following day when the stoppage was ended. The company said its business was unaffected by the workers' action.
The company said a decision had been taken prior to the successful conclusion of talks with employees to close the factory over the New Year. It will reopen on January 3, 1997.
In a statement Draco said the action at its plant had been entirely peaceful and that customer orders were fully covered by inventory stocks.
The wildcat stoppage at Draco was the latest in an uncharacteristic series of industrial disputes this December over annual bonus payments in Thailand.
In the most serious unrest so far, some employees at Sanyo Universal Electrical Plc burnt down some buildings in their plant near Bangkok last week after a year-end bonus dispute.
